name: ANYCAST-LAB
notes:
Non-commercial anycast measurement lab operated by Portalix UG (Munich, Germany). The ASN announces a small IPv6 /48 (and, once leased, an IPv4 /24) from a handful of sites to study anycast catchments.

Measurement etiquette, probe identification and opt-out: https://anycast.org
Commercial measurement services: https://anycast.dev

Active probing is rate-limited, ICMP-only, one packet per target network per run, and honours the published exclusion list. Abuse reports are answered within one business day: abuse@anycast.org
